extension.summary: Otaku RPDev Multi-Provider Subtitle Service (Auto & Manual Search)
extension.description: Integrates Otaku RPDev's built-in online subtitle providers (OpenSubtitles, SubDL, SubSource, Podnapisi, BSPlayer, Addic7ed) into Kodi's OSD Subtitle Settings > Download Subtitle dialog with automatic match indicators and full manual search. Configure providers and credentials under Settings - Otaku RPDev > Subtitles.
